browserEvents.name: page_view

browserEvents.name: ViewContent
browserEvents.trigger: content pages after Meta Pixel is available

browserEvents.name: Lead

browserEvents.trigger: successful non-duplicate lead after server confirms GHL success

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: form_start
eventsToAddBeforeScale.trigger: first focus or interaction with a lead form
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Separates landing page quality from form friction.

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: form_step_complete
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Shows where survey funnels lose people.

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: form_submit_attempt
eventsToAddBeforeScale.trigger: lead form submit before API response
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Finds API failures separate from user intent.

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: form_submit_success
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Confirms frontend success independent of Meta/CRM.

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: form_submit_error
eventsToAddBeforeScale.trigger: validation or API error shown to user

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: product_card_click
eventsToAddBeforeScale.trigger: inventory card or product CTA click
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Identifies winning product cards and copy angles.

eventsToAddBeforeScale.name: inventory_filter_click
eventsToAddBeforeScale.trigger: category, status, sort, or search interaction on inventory pages
eventsToAddBeforeScale.reason: Shows shopper intent before lead submission.

serverEvents.name: Lead
serverEvents.trigger: lead API validates payload, writes Sheets, and GHL upsert succeeds

ga4: Realtime or DebugView shows page_view and generate_lead
metaPixel: Pixel Helper or Events Manager shows PageView, ViewContent, and Lead
metaCapi: Events Manager shows server Lead with matching event_id and no dedupe warning
clarity: Clarity project receives session and custom events
sheets: Lead Vault row receives PENDING then SENT/DUPLICATE/FAILED status
ghl: Contact exists with required tags and custom fields
alerts: Missed lead and failure alert paths are tested or documented
